body_html:
@DanAgins @judyarzt @sedson @jluss I know you each have a WordPress blog as well. I am recruiting folks for user onboarding studies of people as they connect their WordPress blogs to the #indieweb community.

Would love to have you participate. Learn more here and see examples of research: https://indieweb.org/WordPress/Onboarding
